mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER, NAME, EMAIL, PHONE_ENC, REGION_SIDO, REGION_SIGUNGU, STATUS FROM MEMBER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email}) AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT PASSWORD_HASH FROM MEMBER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email}) AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT PASSWORD_HASH FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, NAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD_HASH, PHONE_ENC, REGION_SIDO, REGION_SIGUNGU, STATUS) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{name}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{phoneEnc}, #{regionSido}, #{regionSigungu}, 'ACTIVE')
